requirement.description: {data_dave} proposed that the hand-over from the feature store to the training pipeline should trigger on data arrival. {data_dave.first} wants the training pipeline to start automatically when new feature data arrives, to reduce latency.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: I did not just want the job to start when the data lands; I need the pipeline to verify the schema and row counts before it commits to training. You cannot just fire off a retrain on a corrupted file and hope for the best.
output.correction: That is not a latency issue, that is a data integrity gate. I am asking for a validation step that blocks the training trigger if the feature store hand-over fails, not a faster start.
